CILANTRO_SOAPY_FRACTION: CILANTRO 'soapy' -- OR6A2; a MINORITY. APPROX mid of the ~few%-to-~20% range.

SSAT_RATE: sensory-specific satiety per repeat, for a pure variety-seeker (APPROX)

NOVELTY_SWING: neophobia's push on a NOVEL food's liking (+ for neophilic, - for neophobic)

MERE_EXPOSURE_GAIN: fraction of the gap to full liking that familiarity eventually closes (APPROX)

MERE_EXPOSURE_DECAY: per-exposure approach rate toward that ceiling

JOB_TARGET_LOAD: A production job keeps spare hands until each holder carries at most this share of a full day.
